title: Toxic language detection: a systematic review of Arabic datasets
findings: The survey identified that religious hate speech is a significant and specifically addressed sub-task within Arabic toxic language detection. The paper cataloged multiple datasets created for this purpose, including those focused on religious hate speech in general text (e.g., Albadi et al., 2018), hate speech from bots (Albadi et al., 2019), religiously intolerant videos (Albadi et al., 2022), and Jihadist speech (De Smedt et al., 2018).

measurement_description: The paper is a systematic review of datasets designed for toxic language detection in Arabic. Several of these datasets specifically measure the presence of religious hate speech, including general religious hate, Jihadist hate speech, and hate speech directed at specific religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Jews).
